name: Drawer
purpose: Provide modal side-sheet behavior, focus management, dismissal, portal composition, and edge-placement metadata.
useWhen: A modal task or navigation panel enters from an edge and background content must be unavailable while open.

avoidWhen.condition: The panel is centered, non-modal, or permanently part of page layout.

composition: Compose Trigger and Portal containing Overlay and Content; place Title, Description, and Close inside Content and supply the labeling parts the content requires.

rules.statement: Use Drawer-owned focus trap, focus restoration, scroll lock, Escape, backdrop, and portal behavior instead of rebuilding them.
Give Content an accessible name with Title or an explicit labeling relationship.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Drawer only for its edge appearance while leaving background controls interactive.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Drawer for modal behavior or use a normal inline region when interaction should remain available.

validation: Test trigger focus, initial focus, Tab containment, Escape and backdrop dismissal, Close, scroll lock, and focus return.
Confirm nested portals remain within the modal contract.
